description: Provides guidance on new System.Text.Json APIs introduced in .NET 11. It covers typed JsonTypeInfo access via GetTypeInfo<T> and TryGetTypeInfo<T> on JsonSerializerOptions, and the new JsonNamingPolicy.PascalCase static property. Use when serializing or deserializing JSON in .NET 11 applications and needing typed metadata access or PascalCase property naming.
